text:
alex: quick morale pic drop 436 Toast the corgi discovered the heating vent and now emerges every 20 mins as a toasted loaf. photo: https://i.imgur.com/ToastLoaf.jpg :sparkles:

beatrice: that belly-toes combo!!! absolute perfection. :heart_eyes:

simon: love that he uses the vent like a VIP entrance. next time add a tiny velvet rope. :rofl:

ops-bot: Please remember pets must be leashed in common areas per office policy. See policy: https://intra.redwood/pets.

alex: noted. Toast promises to be on a leash for the meeting room sprint. he will however refuse to wear shoes.

beatrice: plea: someone get a slow-mo of his tiny sprint? i'd like it in perpetuum. :camera_with_flash:

giphy: GIF: corgi zoomies (posted)

simon: also small poll: should we put a "Toast cam" near the vent for emergency smiles? react with :eyes: to veto, :white_check_mark: to greenlight.

alex: :white_check_mark: 100% in favor

beatrice: :white_check_mark: yes pls

simon: :eyes: only if it streams to the break room and not the whole company. privacy-first zoomies.

alex: deal. break-room-only stream. Toast teams up with security to review feed access. :lock:

beatrice: fun fact: Toast's back left paw has a tiny freckle that looks like a heart. he accepts snuggles as payment.

simon: lunchtime demonstration scheduled. bring tiny treats. (reacts: :heart: from beatrice, :joy: from alex)
